nameJa: スケート誌のエディトリアル
headline: WATCH BIG. / REPLY LIVE.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE professionally art-directed Chrome Web Store listing promotional tile for the browser extension YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen.
This is a completed promotional graphic, not a contact sheet or mockup of a design on a device. Canvas must be a landscape rectangle with 11:7 aspect ratio (440:280), approximately 1760x1120. NOT a panoramic banner. Full bleed, clean sharp outer corners, no margins outside the artwork.
Art direction: contemporary sports editorial / independent skateboard magazine. A dramatic original black-and-white photograph-style skateboard contest freeze-frame — one anonymous skater mid-air, a beautifully composed diagonal board silhouette, architectural concrete skatepark and distant crowd rendered with documentary texture and tasteful halftone, no brands/logos on clothing. Deliberate black/cream/vermillion-red palette. Energetic, credible, sophisticated. No neon lights, glowing desks, gaming room, cars, physical monitor hardware or plastic 3D app icons.
Communicate fullscreen video with chat overlay: the skate scene occupies a single LARGE normal 16:9 video field across most of the tile, edge-to-edge in its frame. A single strong red/charcoal, minimal illustrated live-chat panel sits inside the RIGHT side of that SAME video field, about 28% of video width, 72% height; three colored circles and small warm-white horizontal message dashes, a clearly distinguishable rounded composer input row and tiny triangular send symbol at its bottom. No readable messages, usernames, or real comments. Keep skateboarder left of chat so subject remains visible. Add tiny discreet simple fullscreen corner brackets to this single video field. No second chat panel outside.
Typography: set large confidently spaced bold grotesk lettering at LOWER LEFT, as if on a high-quality sports editorial poster. Exact English copy in TWO LINES: "WATCH BIG." / "REPLY LIVE." Beautifully kerned, not italic, no effects, warm white on a small purposeful charcoal area or on negative scene space with impeccable contrast. Large enough for 220x140 thumbnail readability. No other words anywhere.
Constraints: an original conceptual ad illustration, no creator identity, no branded team, no copyrighted franchise, no claim of endorsements, ratings, recommendations, store ranking, downloads or free trial. Do not use YouTube or Chrome official logos. Keep intentional visual hierarchy: editorial action moment, concise headline, chat inside video. Text must be spelled EXACTLY.
conceptNote: 白黒のスポーツ写真風アートと赤。スクリーンの道具感より、配信の一瞬とチャットの関係を伝える。
